competences.description: Attacks the enemy and decreases its Attack Bar by 30% with a 50% chance. When used during the Thunderer state, you attack additionally with lower damage to enemies of the same attribute as the target.
Attacks all enemies 2 times to decrease their Attack Power for 2 turns with a 70% chance. When used during the Thunderer state, leaves a Branding effect for 2 turns with a 70% chance.

effets.description: The target's Attack Power will be decreased by 50%.
The target will receive 25% increased damage.

competences.description: When attacking on your turn, uses the same skill again with reduced damage, additionally granting Silence for 1 turn with a 25% chance. Whenever you attack the enemy on your turn while under the Thunderer state, decreases its Attack Bar by 10% and increases the duration of the Thunderer state by 1 turn with a 25% chance. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: Attacks an additional time on the same turn.
Skills with cooldowns will be locked. (Passive skills not included)

competences.description: Falls under the Thunderer state that enhances your skills for 3 turns and instantly gains another turn. While under the Thunderer state, your Attack Power increases by 100%. Once the Thunderer state ends, you become stunned for 1 turn. In addition, decreases the skill cooldown of [The Flame Thunderer] by 2 turns each when you are not under the Thunderer state.

effets.description: ATK increases by given amount under certain conditions
Reduces cool down counter of skills by 1 or more
effets.note: When you are not under the Thunderer state
